CREATE PROCEDURE [rpt_SuscriptorPaqueteria_ObtenerSuscriptores]
@Membresia_Id INT
AS
BEGIN

SELECT
	[Membresia].[Id],
	[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia],
	[Suscriptor].[Id] AS [suscriptor_Id],
	[Suscriptor].[Nombre],
	[Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico]
FROM [Membresia]
	JOIN [Suscripcion]
		ON [Membresia].[Id] = [Suscripcion].[Membresia_Id]
	JOIN [Suscriptor]
		ON [Suscripcion].[Suscriptor_Id] = [Suscriptor].[Id]
WHERE [Membresia].[Id] = @Membresia_Id

END
Name: rpt_SuscriptorPaqueteria_ObtenerSuscriptores
